{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kussoh Incident''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Essowyn]] when a manager called a [[Miner/Legends|miner]] a "lazy coward." The resulting skirmish left fifteen [[Death/Legends|dead]] before the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] company's security forces could intervene.
